scientific_question: Can a state-conditioned chart recover the co-adapted c_fc/c_proj directions of complete sparse-MoE experts after respecting expert and hidden-neuron permutation symmetries?

symmetry_and_gauge.expert_identity: Match experts jointly by router-logit fingerprints and complete expert residual contributions before pooling across runs.
symmetry_and_gauge.neuron_identity: Match each expert's c_fc row and c_proj column as one functional atom; never align the matrices independently.
symmetry_and_gauge.matching: Maximum-weight bipartite assignment on normalized functional-atom similarity using discovery activations.
symmetry_and_gauge.scale: Retain original paired magnitudes after matching because GELU is not positively homogeneous; normalized similarity is for assignment only.
symmetry_and_gauge.anti_leakage: Use disjoint discovery and held-out activation/token batches for alignment and recovery scoring.

oracles.name: fixed_blockfht_control
oracles.purpose: Separate generator-basis mismatch from symmetry-alignment failure.

oracles.name: static_paired_neuron_chart
oracles.purpose: Measure the best state-independent same-gauge chart at matched coordinate budget.

oracles.name: state_conditioned_paired_neuron_chart
oracles.purpose: Test whether routing/state conditioning closes direction mismatch without making the decoder a dense learned basis.

frozen_diagnostic_gates.expert_occupancy_rule: Do not score an expert until both splits contain at least 256 routed tokens; report excluded experts explicitly.
frozen_diagnostic_gates.authorization: No generated-expert training is authorized unless all gates pass on seed 1 and a confirmatory seed with the same frozen analysis.

confirmatory_acquisition.reason: Seed 1 fixed-eval snapshots give global chords; the denser seed-2 trajectory is required for local tangent and smoothness tests.

interpretation_limits: The dense-expert MoE control validates routing and complete-map specialization, not Mapping Networks compression.
A passing oracle shows representability after correct symmetry handling; it does not by itself prove an efficient trainable decoder.
A failed fixed BlockFHT control with a passing state-conditioned chart localizes the problem to fixed pseudo-random direction mismatch, not MoE routing.
